claim: OD-TBD filed 2026-10-08 from fix/orders-send-blank-followups (PR #672 pr-audits; ADR 0255 addendum of 2026-10-08): requestDraftSend, processScheduledAutoSends and issueManualReplySeal each compare the vendor's providers.restaurant_id with the house before they act on that vendor. In requestDraftSend that is either inside its refuseBlanks closure or on both the waiting-draft and the no-draft path; issueManualReplySeal may do it in manualReplyTarget. OPEN — today none of the three compares it: requestDraftSend lets that vendor's first name fill a greeting blank in its blank check, names that vendor to the managers and, with no draft, inserts a row with its provider_id; the sweep's send rewrites the letter's first greeting to that vendor's first name and mails its address; issueManualReplySeal seals its address. issueDraftSendSeal, approveDraft and getPendingDraft compare it; manualReply compares it when it is not null. The verify reads code with // and /* */ comments removed and accepts either operand order.
